title: ACVC：采用五次新训练的暂定基准结论设计，当前零数值授权
context: 原Convergence完整响应已通过当前科学与规范检查。三次新训练均超过C和自身线索停住规则，但仍有不利世界；Pro选择五次全新训练、每规则64世界的暂定设计，所有旧结果作开发证据。当前仅入库方向设计，不批准训练、C冻结或后续问询。

options.label: 五次新训练的结论设计

packet.question: 在三次新训练的有界收益之后，采用原Convergence选定的五次新训练基准结论设计，还是改为一次B或窄暂缓？

changes_if_approved.to: 采用五次全新训练、每规则64世界、两个独立主比较的暂定设计；本轮实现、训练与冻结预算仍为零

evidence_for.quote: The decisive support is the recurring F advantage over the useful dwell comparator, not merely over always-apply C.
evidence_for.why: F相对有收益的停住规则仍多获约0.064至0.094 J，值得明确下一项有界主张。

evidence_against.quote: Five units cannot establish tail behavior or validate the approximation.
evidence_against.why: 收益不是逐世界保证，且五次训练不足以验证训练分布的尾部；统计结论依赖所声明的小样本模型。

uncertainty: 五次是Pro选定的暂定设计数，不是功效证明或通用门槛。

packet.verdict_text: **Select the provisional, single-task C-BENCH claim-design route, not an automatic fourth B fit and not C promotion.** The next useful question is whether the complete fixed F execution package improves expected endpoint native J by more than 0.01 against C and against own-predicate dwell under the specified fresh-training and evaluation law. I recommend a prospective design of **five genuinely new independent DENSE fits, with 64 paired initial worlds per rule per fit**, final checkpoints only, and the fit-level analysis below. The existing three fresh results justify designing that comparison; they do not already establish its population claim. Five is a bounded design choice with an explicitly provisional, assumption-dependent ceiling, not a power finding or a universal seed requirement. [Science brief §§2–5][brief]; [empirical specification §§5.3 and 11.8.3–11.8.4][spec].
